text: The Living Dead in the Dark
You ended up in an abandoned building with zombies roaming\naround because of the prank Jacky pulled! Try not to get\ncaught by the zombies and find the key to escape!
You found a door and thought you had made it outside, but it\nturned out to be Bemoz's chamber! Zarth came rushing to\nhelp, but the way back got destroyed. Beat Bemoz and escape!
